Red Lantern Corps

Vice

A pincer-jawed Red Lantern.

Vice is a pincer-jawed Red Lantern whose rage makes him dangerous even in captivity. His appearances connect the Red Lanterns’ opening assault with the crisis inside Oa’s prisons.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Red Lantern Corps
First appearance
Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Arkillo’s killing of Vice’s mate drives his hostility toward the Sinestro Corps. Captured by the Green Lanterns, Vice escapes a specially prepared Sciencell and attacks warden Voz, helping turn imprisonment into a wider riot. His later use against Black Lanterns shows how an enemy can become a temporary battlefield asset without becoming safe or trustworthy.

  • Blackest Night: Tales of the Corps
    #1–3 (2009), origin anthology
